title: Ohio BMV Power of Attorney for Certificate of Title
description: Allows a vehicle owner to authorize another person to sign title paperwork and handle BMV title transactions on their behalf.
summary: This form lets you give someone else permission to sign title paperwork and handle BMV transactions for your vehicle. People commonly use this when they cannot go to the BMV in person or when a title agency is handling a vehicle sale.

title: Ohio BMV Application for Certificate of Title to a Motor Vehicle
description: Application for an Ohio certificate of title. Used for obtaining a new title, duplicate title, or transfer of title.
summary: This is the main form used to apply for an Ohio vehicle certificate of title. Use it when you buy a vehicle, lose your title and need a replacement marked "DUPLICATE," or transfer ownership. There is a fee. You will need to provide identification and proof of ownership.

title: Ohio BMV Ownership Assignment and Title Application for Casual Sale
description: Title application and ownership assignment for a casual (private party) sale of a motor vehicle in Ohio.
summary: This form is used when you buy or sell a vehicle through a private sale (not from a dealership) in Ohio. It serves as both the title application and the ownership assignment. The seller signs over the title and the buyer applies for a new title in their name.

title: Hamilton County Auditor Forms Directory
description: Directory of downloadable PDF forms from the Hamilton County Auditor's Office, including conveyance forms, tax exemption applications, dog licensing, and CAUV forms.
summary: The Hamilton County Auditor's forms page includes downloadable forms for real estate transfers, tax exemptions, dog licensing, agricultural use valuation, name change affidavits, and other property-related filings. This is the central page for finding county-level property forms.

title: Hamilton County Vital Records Requests
description: Vital records services from Hamilton County Public Health, including birth and death certificate requests.
summary: Hamilton County Public Health provides certified copies of birth and death certificates for events that occurred in Hamilton County, Ohio. Certified copies are often needed for identification, passports, school registration, estate settlement, and insurance claims. Fees apply and proof of identity is required.
